title: Art Fun Studio

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Art Fun Studio offers engaging and educational art experiences for K-12 students across New York City. We simplify the field trip process by bringing the art studio directly to your school. No need for bus transportation or parent chaperones - our talented instructors handle everything. The scholars enjoyed the visit from Art Fun Studio! Alla was very helpful and always a pleasure! She was patient with the scholars and brought extra canvases for the teachers to join in on the fun! The best part was we got so many beautiful pictures after each of the events she hosted. I am excited to invite Alla back and do an event with our teachers! My students loved the art experience provided by Art Fun
